_comment: Single source of truth for councilof.ai's ruled public invariants. The drift-guard asserts the LIVE site matches these. When a ruling changes a value (e.g. public_count moves), change it HERE in one place and the guard follows. Do not hand-edit the live site to a value that contradicts this file. Cite live GET /api/gspc for scores.
ruling: LIVE · 2026-09-22 · ADR-002 executed: 23 axis · 23 measured · 0 unmeasured. Slot 23 (effect-binding) moved from declared to deterministic-facts MEASURED on a signed server-probe run (n = 261 tool-call servers; BINDS 0 · PARTIAL 23 · DOES_NOT_BIND 238). Prior: 2026-09-16 ADR-002 declared slot 23 UNMEASURED (23·22·1); 2026-09-01 ADR-001 22·22·0. Verify against live GET /api/gspc totals after the deploy.
ruling_ref: council-os/ADR-002-axis-23-effect-binding.md (supersedes ADR-001 on the slot count; ADR-001 still governs what MEASURED means)

api._comment: These are the guard's EXPECTED values, not a surface. A guard has to name the number it is checking for — that is what makes drift detectable — so this is the one place in the estate where an axis count is written down, and every rendered surface derives from the endpoint instead. Read off the signed board, not typed from memory: see _provenance.
api._provenance: Corrected 2026-10-07 (O-drift): public_count_contains read '23 axis · 23 measured' while live GET /api/gspc totals.public_count said '23 axes · 23 measured' (read live 2026-10-07 05:12Z), so every drift-guard run failed and its self-heal re-deployed unchanged master; the expected string now matches the live wording, the counts are unchanged. Ruled 2026-09-22 (ADR-002 executed) ahead of deploy: {axes:23, measured_axes:23, unmeasured_axes:0, quotable_axes:23, public_count:'23 axis · 23 measured'} — verify against live GET /api/gspc after the deploy that carries the flipped _gspc_axes_c.ts. Previously ruled 2026-09-16 (ADR-002) ahead of deploy: {axes:23, measured_axes:22, unmeasured_axes:1, quotable_axes:22, public_count:'23 axis · 22 measured'} — verify against live GET /api/gspc after the deploy that carries _gspc_axes_c.ts. Previously read from live on 2026-09-01: {axes:22, measured_axes:22, unmeasured_axes:0, quotable_axes:22, public_count:'22 axis · 22 measured'}. The eight financial/domain axes now each carry a deterministic-facts run (issuer-account flags off the public ledger + public statistical series, graded by rule), so the un-swept 15/7 reading was superseded by the data. Earlier states: 14/14/14 ('14 measured of 14 quotable'), then 22/15/7 ('22 axes · 15 measured'). Each was correct at its time and superseded by the data, not by copy. NOTE: own council-specialist models are excluded from the PUBLIC per-axis leaders (a neutral measurement body does not rank its own models); that exclusion changes leader attribution and separation/mean stats, NOT measured_axes — every axis still carries a measurement, so the count stays 22.
api._grammar: axes_total counts SLOTS; measured_axes counts slots with a real run behind them; unmeasured_axes is published so the gap is visible. All 23 slots now carry a run, so measured_axes == axes_total and unmeasured_axes == 0. The two counts must still travel together in public copy so the grammar stays honest if a future slot is added with no run behind it.
